svg.title: Pericentric inversion and formation of an inversion loop
svg.desc: Source figure 8.14. Two replicated homologs compare ABCD-centromere-EFG with ABE-centromere-DCFG, then pair in a loop with one indicated nonsister contact. Thin black enclosure marks the inverted interval, not DNA.

g.text: A pericentric inversion includes the centromere
